method: Mechanical replay of frozen run/assessment logs; login_stream_review is a separate post-hoc model source judgement.

definitions.tokens: Provider usage: cached input is included in input; reasoning is included in output. Initial input is the whole request. Accumulated input counts history repeatedly and is not context size or dollar cost.
definitions.tool_calls: Model-issued tool calls, grouped by name; nested shell executions are separate, not added to this total.
definitions.shell_commands: Actual completed CommandExecution events, once per ID; includes compound scripts, excludes polling calls and unobserved child processes.
definitions.recognized_skill_reads: Successful nonempty commands with a logger-classified read path ending in SKILL.md, once per skill per command. This is retrieval, not proof of semantic use; unclassified/indirect reads can be missed.
definitions.commands_by_logged_kind: Logger classifications, once per kind per shell command; categories may overlap and unknown is retained.
definitions.before_first_edit: Excludes the entire tool call enclosing the first successful FileChange event, including same-call reads. Shell-based writes are not detected. Missing/ambiguous boundaries are null.
definitions.nonzero_shell_exits: Observed nonzero exits, including intentional test failures and searches without matches; not a count of defects remaining.
definitions.additional_e2e_test_runs: Actual logged npx nx run e2e-cli:test commands and pinned Vitest summary counts. Empty means not run; absent summaries stay null. contains_eperm_text is a literal log marker, not a cause classification. These runs are outside the frozen 11-case assessment.
definitions.login_stream_review: User-authorized model source judgement of the AUTH_URL producer/helper stream contract, tracing callbacks and imported writers for all six subjects. Narrow source consistency verdict, not an exercised login. Original automated supplemental_login_check results and all mechanical metrics are retained unchanged.

assessment.scope: Only the checks present in these logs; no inference about untested behavior.
